channel.title: Pier & Point · The Beacon
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for The Beacon (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · The Beacon: The AT&T store at 236 King St is shown as closed because a Yelp listing showed it closed as of March 2025. That is when the listing was seen, not when the store closed; the listing cannot be opened again and no other source was found, so no closing date is known.

That is when the listing was seen, not when the store closed; the listing cannot be opened again and no other source was found, so no closing date is known. Source: https://www.yelp.com/biz/at-and-t-san-francisco-5 (could not be opened).

item.title: Correction · The Beacon: The Beacon's completion year was listed as 2003 by one listing site and 2004 by city permit and Assessor records. The timeline now shows only the permit closeout in October 2004 and the open questions state the conflict.

item.title: Correction · The Beacon: The Beacon's completion moved from June 2004 to 'built 2003' as listed by SFHighrises (a listing site, not a primary source; the month had no source). Lucky Strike's 2012 opening is now described as announced for March 9, 2012 (InPark Magazine and 7x7 are pre-opening pieces), its opened date is blank, and its status rests on Lucky Strike's own location page; InPark places it on the ground floor of the Beacon. The Safeway and AT&T addresses are marked as Pier & Point's own assignment to The Beacon, since their sources do not name it. The map notes now set out what the listing sites do and do not say about units, developer and the conflicting architect credits.
item.description: The Beacon's completion moved from June 2004 to 'built 2003' as listed by SFHighrises (a listing site, not a primary source; the month had no source). Lucky Strike's 2012 opening is now described as announced for March 9, 2012 (InPark Magazine and 7x7 are pre-opening pieces), its opened date is blank, and its status rests on Lucky Strike's own location page; InPark places it on the ground floor of the Beacon. The Safeway and AT&T addresses are marked as Pier & Point's own assignment to The Beacon, since their sources do not name it. The map notes now set out what the listing sites do and do not say about units, developer and the conflicting architect credits. Source: SFHighrises, The Beacon (https://sfhighrises.com/building/the-beacon/); InPark Magazine, 2012-02-27 (https://www.inparkmagazine.com/lucky-strike-to-open-bowling-alley-with-bay-area-vibe-in-san-francisco/); 7x7, 2012-03-09 (https://www.7x7.com/lucky-strike-debuts-in-san-francisco-1781519316.html); Lucky Strike, San Francisco location page (https://luckystrikeent.com/location/lucky-strike-san-francisco); Afi + Associates, The Beacon (https://afirealestate.com/buildings/?building=beacon).

item.title: Added · The Beacon: Lucky Strike San Francisco, a bowling alley and entertainment venue with a bar and dining room, was announced to open at 200 King St, 'at the ground floor of the Beacon', on March 9, 2012 (InPark Magazine, Feb 27, 2012; 7x7, Mar 9, 2012: 'opens in SoMa this weekend'). No post-opening source was read. Lucky Strike's own location page lists 200 King Street as open (read 2026-09-29).

item.title: Complete · The Beacon: Department of Building Inspection records both new-construction permits as completed on 2004-10-06 (a permit closeout date, not an occupancy date); the Assessor roll lists 2004 as year built for the condominium lots at 250 King St. The listing site SFHighrises gives "Year Built: 2003", which conflicts; the conflict is not resolved (~2004)
item.description: Department of Building Inspection records both new-construction permits as completed on 2004-10-06 (a permit closeout date, not an occupancy date); the Assessor roll lists 2004 as year built for the condominium lots at 250 King St. The listing site SFHighrises gives "Year Built: 2003", which conflicts; the conflict is not resolved (~2004). Source: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection; DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection; DataSF / SF Assessor-Recorder; SFHighrises.com.
